en: A black‑and‑white image of an older bearded man dressed as a traditional rural postman, carrying a large mailbag over his shoulder and holding a suitcase. He stands on the front step of a small wooden house with a dark door and climbing plants covering the facade. A tall stone stands in the foreground to the left, and there is a window with ivy on the right. The whole scene has an early‑20th‑century, Northern European village atmosphere.
